title: Which tag tagstats.py prints second for the sample export
prompt:
I'm about to wire `tagstats.py` (in this repository) into our weekly digest email and want to double-check its output first. When I run

    python3 tagstats.py data/posts.txt --top 3

which tag is printed on the SECOND line of output?

Answer with the tag as it is printed, including the leading `#` (e.g. `#example`).
